rules.match: exact: the stored native equals the number the publisher printed (its own rounding; float noise below 1e-9 ignored); the chart native equals the stored native to 1e-9
rules.publisher_vs_stored: red on any publisher player missing from the stored bake, stored player not on the publisher page, value mismatch, page week != stored week, or a different article; amber when the publisher revised the page after the save and less than 24 h ago, or when publisher names do not resolve to a canonical player
rules.fantasycalc: FantasyCalc is a live crowd feed with no versioned snapshot, so values that moved since the save are amber and listed (players outside the max(25%, 50 points) band by name). Red: more than 10% of values outside that band (a broken save, not movement); a stored list closer to another live list (scoring or QB setting) than to its own by 1.5x (column swap); a player above the list's churn line (its 15th-percentile value) on one side only
rules.universe: players the chart's player universe (the chart file's player_keys) excludes are amber and listed by name: the publisher values them, the page cannot show them
rules.stored_vs_chart: red on any difference between the live chart's native values and the stored bake the chart was built from; amber when a newer stored bake (different values) is not on the chart yet
rules.freshness: amber when the publisher posted a newer week than the chart shows less than 24 h ago, red after that
rules.reference_vs_engine: red when the JEG-479 value check reports a disagreement for the source; n/a while no report is published
rules.projections: ESPN, CBS rest of season, Razzball: stage 1 compares the publisher's own numbers with the newest stored snapshot in the publisher's unit (ESPN and CBS rest-of-season totals, Razzball per game), exactly. A difference is red when the publisher still serves the content the save read (the source probe's fingerprint recorded with the save equals the one read now: stored != same-version publisher), or when a block of players is missing or extra (more than 10% of a position, at least 3). It is amber while the publisher's own update stamp is newer than the snapshot (inside 24 h), the change probe has seen content no ingest saved yet, or the fingerprint changed since the save (a daily update; red once the save is older than 24 h: stale), and amber 'unconfirmed' when no fingerprint was recorded with the save or none can be read now. ESPN (Jeremy 2026-10-10, 'Amber, then re-sync'): every such amber is 'update available' and the pulse dispatches the ESPN sync (one request per publisher version per 3 h); only a mismatch that survives the re-sync is red. Stage 2: the chart's per-game native equals the stored snapshot it was built from, rounded half-up to the chart's printed decimals. Stage 3: chart snapshot older than 1 d amber, 3 d red, or the publisher's own update date is newer than the chart's
rules.scrape_validity: signals that a scrape may have missed (Jeremy 2026-10-09): a position's stored or chart player count below 95% of the prior week's is amber (alert only), below 90% red (held) when the publisher's own list for that position did not drop below 90% too (if it did, or it was not read, amber); JEG-482 published-rank inversions are red; so is a sentinel star (Allen, Lamar Jackson, Mahomes, Gibbs, Nacua, Bowers) on a projection source's chart outside his per-game band derived from other sources (JEG-592, JEG-807). A player absent from a fully loaded chart means 0; absences that may be processing errors are stages 1 and 2
rules.rollup: a source is the worst of its stages; unknown (input unreadable) counts as amber
rules.hold: JEG-520: a red in publisher_vs_stored, stored_vs_chart, freshness or scrape_validity holds that source and its derived series (the chain's validationHold, reason 'fidelity: <stage>'): kept out of DDF Value, labelled, a published chart served from its last good section. Amber and unknown never hold; reference_vs_engine reds are already held by the JEG-479 value check. While held, stored_vs_chart is n/a (the chart shows the kept section) unless the hold was stored_vs_chart on the same stored save, which stays red until a newer save; freshness reads the stored week or snapshot instead of the chart's.
rules.tolerance: per-source tolerance (JEG-520, measured in docs/fidelity-tolerances.md): FantasyCalc live-feed movement band max(25%, 50 points), red only above 10% of values outside it; article charts exact against the same article version, a later revision is 'update available' for 24 h, then stale; projections exact against the same publisher version (probe fingerprint), a changed version amber for 24 h, then stale; ESPN amber, then re-sync: red only when the mismatch survives a fresh sync
rules.resave: stage 2: a same-day re-save after the chart was built (the snapshot's last row write, or the probe fingerprint acknowledged with that save, is after the chart's raw_built_at) is amber until the next chain run for every changed, added or dropped player stage 1 shows equal to the publisher

universe.definition: Every QB/RB/WR/TE Sleeper lists on an NFL team (active roster, practice squad, injured reserve, PUP and other reserve lists), plus free agents Sleeper flags active. A rostered player needs a Sleeper news item in the 365 days before the identity pull, a free agent one in the 90 days (a rostered player may instead carry Sleeper's practice-squad status), which drops retired players Sleeper still lists on a team. Practice squad is Sleeper's status, or inferred for a rostered player with no depth-chart slot.
